name: ACP Protocol Security
purpose: Verify Agent Client Protocol transport security, authentication tokens, and channel isolation.
inputs: ACP transport and session architecture, peer registry, and trust model
Delegation graph, capability scopes, session identifiers, and message schemas
Replay, quarantine, cancellation, token-budget, and abuse-test requirements
outputs: ACP boundary and delegation audit with severity-ranked findings
Validated message, capability, and handoff contract recommendations
Replay, isolation, cancellation, and budget-enforcement test evidence
stop_conditions: No unauthenticated route, capability escalation, replay, or cross-session leakage remains
Cancellation and token exhaustion terminate descendants deterministically
Token budget exhausted or protocol authority is unavailable
